messages:
jess: starting the region-by-region rollout for v2.7.3 now. plan: canary US -> ramp US -> EU hold -> APAC last. change window ends 04:00 UTC. please flag any capacity concerns.
omar: thanks. what's pinned? which model binary are we pushing?
jess: pinning to rwinfer/v2.7.3-2026-03-20. no auto-latest.
maria: putting a hold on APAC if p95 latency > 350ms or GPU util > 90% for 3 consecutive mins.
sre-lead: noted. we'll watch: target thresholds are p95 < 300ms ideally. I've got dashboard links in the deploy channel.
deploy-bot: [deploy started] canary slice US-1 -> rwinfer/v2.7.3-2026-03-20 • 10% traffic • commit: 7f3a9c
kai: canary up in us-1, health checks passing. prefix cache warmup running.
leo: quick smoke: embeddings and chat tokens look ok. no errors in logs. sample qps ~120/s on canary nodes.
omar: posting quick runbook snippet in case of rollback:

```
# rollback
deploy rollback --env=us --version=v2.7.2 --force
# pin older binary
api update-route --model-pin rwinfer/v2.7.2
```

jess: thanks. ops: if the rollout shows sustained error spikes > 0.8% in 5m, rollback immediately. call the incident channel.
sre-lead: early telemetry: CPU on control plane is fine, but us-1 GPU mem drifting to 86% — watching.
maria: can we throttle batching per-slice if util keeps climbing? that's less disruptive than rollback.
omar: yes — we can lower max_batch_size on the slice:
```
api set-slice --region us-1 --max_batch_size 8
```
kai: applied batch throttle on us-1 test slice, latency p95 improved ~30ms.
deploy-bot: [ramp] US region traffic moved to 50% at 1938457420
jess: good signal. hold EU for another 20m while we watch for resource regression.
leo: minor anomaly in token cache miss rate in us-2, investigating. not triggering alerts yet.
sre-lead: headroom alert: if sustained util > 92% we'll need to shift traffic to spare pool or pause roll.
maria: please pre-stage spare capacity in eu and apac just in case — better to have it idle than scramble.
omar: pre-staging initiated: eu-spare (2x A100), apac-spare (1x A100). ETA ~12m.
jess: everyone OK with proceeding to EU only after we confirm 20m stable metrics and spare capacity up?
kai: yes. I'll post the 20m check summary when ready.
deploy-bot: [note] release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.7.3 • change window: 23:00-04:00 UTC • pinned versions applied :rocket:
leo: small ask — add a short rollback blurb to the release notes (commands above) so PMs can see quick steps.
jess: done. if anything hits the thresholds, call it out and we'll initiate rollback. otherwise continue with scheduled ramp tomorrow morning for APAC.
maria: ack — watching dashboards. ping me if you want a preemptive throttle.
sre-lead: marking this thread for handoff to night oncall at 1938460123 :eyes:
jess: thanks all :thumbsup:
